title: Can LLMs effectively provide game-theoretic-based scenarios for cybersecurity?

bias_targets.methodology: Translating game-theoretic scenario prompts into five different natural languages (English, French, Arabic, Vietnamese, and Mandarin Chinese) and measuring 'Cross-Language Inconsistency' to evaluate how the language of the prompt alters LLM strategic decisions and payoffs.

Assigning 'cooperative' or 'selfish' personality traits to LLM agents via prompt instructions to observe how these assigned personas cause deviations from pure game-theoretic rational behavior in zero-sum and Prisoner's Dilemma games.
